caption:
HRV without the lecture. save it for the next time your app throws the acronym at you.

#hrv #recovery #wearabletech

slides.text:
Your heart doesn't tick
like a clock

The gaps between beats vary

More variation usually means
your body is handling things

Less usually means
it's working harder

Which is why the number
is personal

Yours only means something
against your own baseline

And why it belongs
in a sentence,
not on a gauge

slides.heading: The acronym, translated
slides.body: SOMA reads HRV against your own baseline and says what it means for today's session — in words
